fixes.explanation: Ezra is a priest himself (Ezra 7:12), so I see why you grabbed that one. But the letter says he's sent "…to evaluate Judah and Jerusalem according to the Law of your God, which is in your hand." (Ezra 7:14) Being a priest is a fine job, but it's not the measuring tape. Think of a cookie inspector who checks every batch against his own mood. Nope, he needs the recipe card, and Ezra's got the Law right there in his hand.
